summary: A limestone Imperial tower on Lake Huron, lit in April 1859 to mark an offshore shoal, restored and reopened in 2015.

notes_for_editor: Mostly rests on Lighthouse Friends (copyrighted, facts only, paraphrased) plus Parks Canada and Register statements. Canada's pre-1900 Public Works reports and Parks Canada's DFHD statements could not be read (pages are placeholders). Marine branch keeper tables are OCR column blocks, so only one name hit was used. The 1902, 1910 and 1919 volumes cover the report for 1901, fiscal 1908-09 and fiscal 1917-18 (checked against the volumes' title pages). Alleged discrepancies: record says automated 1960; sources say 1962 or mid-1960s; 1924 automation attempt was reversed in 1926. Wikipedia was used only for leads.
